clauses.from: the membership check is O(N^2) per c, so ALL c costs O(N^3) = 4.7e7 at N = 361 -- NOT affordable. The registration therefore DECLARES A REDUCED SCOPE (all c at N <= 49, sample of 6 above) rather than silently sampling. THE CAP IS THE DEMAND ONLY BECAUSE THE SCOPE WAS CUT TO MEET IT, AND THE CUT IS PRINTED WITH THE RESULT.
